titleEn: How Much Does a Whole House Renovation Cost in Metro Vancouver 2026?
titleZh: 2026年大温地区整体翻新费用是多少？
contentEn:
A whole house renovation in Metro Vancouver in 2026 typically costs between $23,000 and $28,000 for a mid-range project, depending on scope, finishes, and the condition of the existing structure. Reno Stars has completed whole-house renovations in Vancouver and Richmond at these price points, with timelines ranging from two weeks for cosmetic-only refreshes to five weeks for full gut renovations that include structural updates, bathroom remodels, and new flooring throughout.

This guide breaks down every cost category, shows real project examples from the Metro Vancouver market, and tells you exactly what drives the final number so you can budget accurately before you sign a contract.

What Does a Whole House Renovation Include in Vancouver?

A true whole-house renovation in Metro Vancouver covers the interior of a single-family home or townhouse from top to bottom. Reno Stars defines it as work spanning at least three of the five main living zones: kitchen, bathrooms, main living area, flooring, and structural or exterior envelope updates. Partial updates — a single bathroom, one room, or just new flooring — fall into their scoped renovation tiers and cost less per square foot.

What Drives the Cost of a Whole House Renovation in Metro Vancouver?

1. Scope and Size. Square footage is the single biggest variable. A 1,200 sq ft townhouse costs less to gut-renovate than a 2,800 sq ft detached home. Reno Stars prices per project, not per square foot, which means you get one clear total — not a running meter that climbs as the job progresses.

2. Kitchen Complexity. A full kitchen gut — new cabinets, quartz countertops, appliance installation, plumbing rerouting — adds $8,000–$15,000 to a whole-house budget depending on cabinetry grade and whether the layout changes.

3. Number of Bathrooms. Each full bathroom renovation (tile, vanity, toilet, shower/tub, plumbing connections) adds $4,500–$9,000. A second bath in the same job typically costs 15–20% less per fixture due to shared trade mobilization.

4. Flooring Throughout. Replacing flooring in a whole house — LVP, hardwood, or tile — runs $3.50–$8.50 per square foot installed. For a 1,800 sq ft home, that is $6,300–$15,300 for the floor package alone.

5. Age of Home and Hidden Conditions. Vancouver homes built before 1985 frequently have outdated wiring, cast-iron plumbing, and insufficient insulation. Opening walls may reveal conditions that add 10–20% to the budget. Reno Stars includes a pre-project condition assessment in every free quote.

6. Finish Level. Standard grade finishes (laminate counters, vinyl plank, mid-tier fixtures) sit at the lower end of each range. Premium finishes (quartz, custom tile, designer fixtures) push costs toward the upper end.

How Long Does a Whole House Renovation Take in Vancouver?

A mid-range whole-house renovation in Metro Vancouver takes four to five weeks on average, based on Reno Stars' 2025–2026 project history. Cosmetic-only refreshes can be completed in two to three weeks. Full structural gut renovations — where walls are reconfigured, plumbing is rerouted, or the electrical panel is upgraded — typically require six to ten weeks including permit processing time for any structural or electrical permits required by the City of Vancouver or the respective municipality.

For projects over $20,000, many clients explore a home improvement loan or HELOC (Home Equity Line of Credit) using their existing home equity. The team can provide the documentation lenders require — detailed scope, line-item quote, and timeline — as part of the free estimate package.

Frequently Asked Questions About Whole House Renovation Costs in Metro Vancouver

What is the average cost of a whole house renovation in Vancouver in 2026?

The average mid-range whole house renovation in Vancouver costs between $23,000 and $28,000 for a project that includes a full kitchen remodel, one to two bathroom renovations, new flooring throughout, and interior painting. Premium projects with structural changes can reach $30,000 to $55,000 or more.

Do I need a permit for a whole house renovation in Vancouver?

Most whole-house cosmetic renovations — painting, flooring, fixture replacement, kitchen cabinet refinishing — do not require a City of Vancouver building permit. Structural changes, electrical panel upgrades, and any work that alters load-bearing walls require a permit. Reno Stars handles permit coordination as part of their project management service.

How do I choose a contractor for a whole house renovation in Metro Vancouver?

Verify that your contractor is licensed with BC Consumer Protection Association, ask for a written quote that itemizes every scope item, and request references from at least three completed projects of similar size. Reno Stars provides a free in-person estimate, a detailed written quote, and a project timeline before any contract is signed.

Does flooring affect the total renovation budget significantly?

Yes. Flooring is one of the largest single line items in a whole-house renovation. Replacing flooring in a 1,800 sq ft home costs $6,300 to $15,300 depending on material selection — LVP at the lower end, solid hardwood or large-format tile at the upper end. It should be accounted for separately in your budget from the start.

Can I live in my home during a whole house renovation?

For cosmetic-level whole-house renovations, many Metro Vancouver homeowners remain in the home for the duration, particularly if the work is sequenced room by room. For full gut renovations involving kitchen and all bathrooms, most clients prefer to relocate for the duration of the most disruptive phases. Reno Stars plans the work sequence to minimize displacement and keeps dust barriers in place throughout.

温哥华整体房屋翻新在2026年的价格通常在23,000至28,000加元之间，具体取决于工程范围、装修档次和房屋现有结构状况。Reno Stars已在温哥华和列治文完成了多个整体翻新项目，工期从两周的表面翻新到五周的全屋改造（包括结构更新、浴室翻新和全屋地板铺设）不等。

温哥华整体翻新包含哪些项目？

真正的整体房屋翻新涵盖独立屋或联排别墅的内部，从上到下全面施工。Reno Stars将整体翻新定义为至少涵盖五个主要区域的三个：厨房、浴室、客厅、地板和结构/外层更新。部分装修（单间浴室、一个房间或仅更换地板）属于他们的分项装修类别，按每平方英尺计价更低。

2026年大温地区整体翻新费用明细

装修档次预估费用范围典型工期包含项目
表面翻新$18,000 – $23,0002–3周油漆、地板、踢脚线、灯具、橱柜翻新、浴室装置升级
中档整体翻新$23,000 – $28,0004–5周全屋厨房改造、两间浴室翻新、全屋地板铺设、电路更新、室内油漆
高端/结构级$30,000 – $55,000+6–10周结构改造、布局重新配置、管道改线、全屋厨房和浴室精装、定制橱柜

这些价格区间反映了Reno Stars在2025至2026年间在温哥华和列治文的实际项目记录。每份报价均为免费且无义务——实际价格因房屋状况、电线和管道使用年限及选材档次而异。

  • 温哥华整体翻新+浴室升级 — $23,000–$25,000，四至五周工期，全屋翻新含浴室精装和地板更换

影响大温地区整体翻新费用的因素

1. 工程范围和面积。建筑面积是最大的变量。1,200平方英尺的联排别墅的翻新费用低于2,800平方英尺的独立屋。Reno Stars按项目定价而非按平方英尺计价，这意味着您获得的是一个清晰的总价，而非不断攀升的计时账单。

2. 厨房复杂度。全屋厨房精装——新橱柜、石英石台面、设备安装、管道改线——根据橱柜等级和是否改变布局，需额外支付$8,000至$15,000。

3. 浴室数量。每间全屋浴室翻新（瓷砖、洗手台、马桶、淋浴/浴缸、管道连接）需增加$4,500至$9,000。同一项目的第二间浴室通常因共享人工成本而降低15–20%。

4. 全屋地板。全屋地板更换——LVP地板、实木地板或瓷砖——安装费用为每平方英尺$3.50至$8.50。对于1,800平方英尺的房屋，地板部分费用为$6,300至$15,300。

5. 房屋年代和隐藏状况。1985年前建造的温哥华房屋通常电线老旧、铸铁管道、隔热不足。开墙后可能发现额外问题，使预算增加10–20%。Reno Stars在每次免费报价中均包含项目前状况评估。

温哥华整体翻新需要多长时间？

根据Reno Stars在2025至2026年的项目记录，大温地区中档整体翻新平均需要四至五周。纯表面翻新可在两至三周内完成。涉及墙壁重新配置、管道改线或电路面板升级的全屋精装翻新通常需要六至十周（包括温哥华市或相关市政府的许可审批时间）。

常见问题

2026年温哥华整体翻新的平均费用是多少？

温哥华中档整体翻新的平均费用在$23,000至$28,000之间，包含全屋厨房精装、一至两间浴室翻新、全屋地板铺设和室内油漆。高端项目（含结构改造）可达$30,000至$55,000或更高。

温哥华整体翻新需要许可证吗？

大多数整体房屋 Cosmetic 翻新——油漆、地板、装置更换、橱柜翻新——不需要温哥华市建筑许可证。结构改造、电路面板升级以及任何改变承重墙的工程均需许可证。Reno Stars作为项目管理服务的一部分处理许可协调事宜。

大温地区整体翻新期间可以住在家里吗？

对于中档整体翻新，许多大温地区的业主可以在整个施工期间留在家中，特别是如果工程是按房间顺序进行的。对于涉及厨房和所有浴室的全屋精装翻新，大多数客户更愿意在最混乱的阶段搬离。Reno Stars精心规划施工顺序，最大限度减少干扰，并在整个施工期间保持防尘屏障。
